blocks.label: Morris inorder core
blocks.py:
cur = root
while cur:
    if not cur.left:
        visit(cur); cur = cur.right
    else:
        pred = cur.left
        while pred.right and pred.right is not cur: pred = pred.right
        if not pred.right:              # thread create
            pred.right = cur; cur = cur.left
        else:                            # thread unlink - visit now
            pred.right = None; visit(cur); cur = cur.right

blocks.md: **Amortized proof sentence: each EDGE traversed ≤3 times (thread-create, descend, thread-remove) ⇒ O(n) time, O(1) space.**

blocks.label: binary lifting LCA build + query
blocks.py:
# up[k][v] = 2^k-th ancestor; LOG ~ 20 for n <= 10^6
up = [[0]*n for _ in range(LOG)]
# build: up[k][v] = up[k-1][up[k-1][v]]

def kth_anc(v, k):
    for j in range(LOG):
        if k >> j & 1: v = up[j][v]
    return v

def lca(a, b):
    if dep[a] < dep[b]: a, b = b, a
    a = kth_anc(a, dep[a] - dep[b])     # equalize depths
    if a == b: return a
    for j in reversed(range(LOG)):
        if up[j][a] != up[j][b]: a, b = up[j][a], up[j][b]
    return up[0][a]
